issue.title: [Bug] Replacement strings containing $ corrupt every string_replace and diff_edit

steps: Create script.sh with exactly #!/bin/sh, echo "old", exit 0 on three LF-separated lines, with a final newline. Read it with read_file.

Use string_replace on script.sh, replacing echo "old" with exactly this literal text:
echo "pid=$$ match=$& pre=$` post=$'"
Then inspect the saved bytes.
expected: The replacement text is inserted literally, preserving all four JavaScript replacement-token sequences.
defect: The edit tool expands $$, $&, $` and $' in new_str, silently changing content and duplicating file context.

fault location.explanation: string_replace calls String.replace(old_str, new_str), and diff_edit does the same per block. A string replacement parameter invokes JavaScript substitution semantics; a function replacer would preserve the supplied text literally.

Root cause: string_replace calls String.replace(old_str, new_str), and diff_edit does the same per block. A string replacement parameter invokes JavaScript substitution semantics; a function replacer would preserve the supplied text literally.
